text: If that man likes you, he's gonna text you within hours after your first or second date. Like, he is gonna text you and let you know he had a good time and set up the next date. If he doesn't and he waits like, I don't know, a day or two or whatever, it's not looking good. Big mistake guys do after the first date texting the girl and thanking her for the evening. If you invited her, organized everything, paid for the drinks, she should be the one texting thank you after the date. Think about it. If you invite guests to your home, cook dinner, get wine, you don't text them afterwards saying how great it was. They thank you for being a good host. Same rule here. But if she doesn't text, do not worry. It's also quite normal. If you want to see her again, wait a day or two, then invite her out. That way you show you're not needy, you've got things going on, but you are still interested in meeting.
